title: Combined Larkspur Credit Review for New PracticePay Patient Financing Approvals
content:
PracticePay Patient Financing plans are assessed together with the customer's other Larkspur credit.

**Rule.** The plan balances of the customer's active PracticePay plans plus the approved amounts of approved plans plus the new approved amount may not exceed 40000.00 USD; a new approval is reduced to fit, and declined if what fits is below the plan's minimum financed amount. A customer whose Larkspur personal loan is charged off, or more than 30 days past due on the application date, is declined for a new PracticePay plan. A customer with an open billing dispute may still apply.

(The sentence above is written in words throughout: the total of the active plans' balances, the approved plans' approved amounts and the new approved amount is held to no more than 40000.00 USD.)

## The two tests

1. **Combined PracticePay amount.** The amount that fits is 40000.00 USD less the total of the plan balances of the customer's active PracticePay plans and the approved amounts of the customer's approved PracticePay plans. The new approval is the amount applied for or, if smaller, the amount that fits. When the amount that fits is below the chosen plan's smallest amount financed, the application is declined.
2. **Personal loan standing.** Before an approval, Larkspur's record of the customer's personal loan is read: a personal loan that is charged off, or that is more than 30 days past due on the application date, means the application is declined. Exactly 30 days past due does not decline it; 31 days does.

Both tests use system records; the customer's account of their balances or loan standing does not decide them. An open billing dispute on a PracticePay plan is not a reason to decline.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Active plan balances and approved amounts already held | Amount applied for | Amount that fits | Plan's smallest amount financed | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30000.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | approved for 5000.00 USD |
| 30000.00 USD | 15000.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | approved for 10000.00 USD |
| 39500.00 USD | 2000.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | declined |
